info.title: Touring After the Apocalypse
info.synopsis: Completamente sole dopo la fine della civiltà, due ragazze cavalcano una moto tra le rovine desolate del Giappone, ma non hanno intenzione di lasciare che tutto questo ostacoli il loro giro turistico! Dalle sorgenti termali di Hakone all'enorme Tokyo Big Sight, hanno a disposizione tutti per loro i luoghi turistici più popolari della nazione, quindi perché non approfitarne?

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: This is a post-apocalyptic world. Yoko and Airi travel freely on their electric bike, Serow. Their destination this time is Hakone.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Their journey takes them from Hakone to Yokohama. They pass by collapsed bridges and see skyscrapers floating in the sea. As the two set out in search of food, an unexpected encounter awaits them.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Yoko and Airi get thirsty on their way to Tokyo, so they make a pit stop at Todoroki Ravine in Setagaya. After they quench their thirst, they walk around empty houses looking for food.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: The girls visit Akihabara to find the source of Akiba Radio's transmission. As they explore the ruins of the former Electric Town, they come across butler and maid costumes - leading them to have some fun cosplaying.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: They leave Akihabara and head over to Umihotaru, a rest stop on the way from Chiba. The girls run into trouble with the Serow as they struggle to ride it across the expansive wetlands of Nagareyama.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: Leaving a storm in Tokyo Bay's Aqua-Line behind, the girls finally arrive in Umihotaru. They explore the area in the darkness until the rain stops.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: The girls arrive at the Tsukuba Expo Center to carry out some maintenance for Airi. That's when a seemingly ordinary telephone booth there suddenly...

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: The Touringram gets updated, and a stamp function is added. Yoko and Airi head over to Kasumigaura to collect the nearest stamp.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: Yoko and Airi want to ride on a circuit, so they head over to Mobility Resort Motegi. There, they encounter ISAAQ, a robot handling reception.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: The girls' journey brings them to Oarai. After spending a night on a ferry at Oarai Port, they reflect on the journey they could have taken to Hokkaido abroad that very ferry.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: After leaving Nikko, Airi hears a mysterious sound only she can hear. They head to the origins of that sound, to find out that it's the Yoshimi Hundred Caves in Saitama, a historical site.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: After camping on the shores of Lake Shirakaba, Yoko and Airi head over to Venus Line, the best touring spot often considered sacred ground among riders. As they emerge from a dense fog, what the two see is—.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: With the return of Yang to the battlefield, the Imperial fleet increasingly loses momentum and is now on the verge of collapse. Admiral Kempff has to come to terms with the fact that his forces are no longer capable of holding the front line, and sends an order of general retreat to all ships. But this is not necessarily an admission of defeat, because he has one last card to play.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: The Imperial invasion force returns to the capital Odin, where Reinhard shows very different treatment to the personnel involved in the operation. Meanwhile, dissatisfaction with the new leadership is unexpectedly growing in the heart of one who was once the Empire's most loyal war hero. At Iserlohn Fortress, where peace has temporarily been restored, Yang and Julian have a very frank conversation, and Julian reveals the path he has chosen.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Military Police Commander Ulrich Kesler informs Reinhard that Count Alfred von Landsberg and Leopold Schumacher, two former members of the now-dissolved Lippstadt Nobles Coalition that fought against Reinhard during the Civil War, have reportedly infiltrated the Imperial capital of Odin. Unsure of their true intentions, Reinhard first asks Hilde to assure Annerose's safety, then summons Fezzani High Commissioner Boltik. It's June of the 489th year of the Imperial Calendar...

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Count Landsberg's family had loyally served the Goldenbaum dynasty for five generations. His ancestors were even involved in the construction of a labyrinthic system of tunnels beneath the Neue Sanssouci Palace, devised to provide a safe escape for the Emperor in case of an emergency. Now this underground maze will prove instrumental in rescuing the Emperor from the usurper.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: Kesler reports to Reinhard that the palace has been breached during the night. The sun has yet to rise when Reinhard urgently summons his senior admirals and orders them to keep all fleets ready to go into action at any time. Hilde is now beginning to see the byzantine game of power that is being played in cold-blooded cynicism, but in the midst of this, she overhears communication concerning Neue Sanssouci Chief of Security Molt.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: In a sudden public speech from Heinessen directed to all citizens, Chairman Trunicht announces that epoch-changing events are occurring as a most unexpected defector has arrived seeking protection under the ideals of freedom and democracy in the Alliance. Everyone on Iserlohn is puzzled, but Yang has a hunch that makes him feel aggravated. Then, news from Odin casts an ominous shadow across the entire galaxy.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: Reinhard's speech has thrown the whole High Council of the Free Planets Alliance into complete chaos. Public opinion is polarized between disapproval of a folly populist decision, and support for a resolution that honors the core values of the Alliance. For Trunicht, there couldn't be better opportunity to further strengthen his influence over the military. As the future of the galaxy seems to hinge upon a bratty seven-year-old, Julian is appointed with a new assignment that would take him right to the eye of the growing storm.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: Julian is deeply hesitant about his new assignment in Fezzan. Wouldn't he be more helpful to the Alliance's cause by staying at Iserlohn, where the Imperial fleet is more likely to strike, making any available pilot sorely needed in the near future? However, Yang believes that this otherwise unwelcome top-down decision may actually turn out to be crucial to obtaining invaluable insight on where the struggle for power in the galaxy is heading.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: As the new wind of war seems to reinvigorate the will to fight among the Empire's youth, the military machine moves on to mobilize an attack force of unprecedented proportions. At the Supreme Operations Council, Reinhard reveals his audacious plan, not without sparking bewilderment and skepticism among the assembled admirals. Meanwhile, Heydrich Lang, former chief of the much-feared Department of Social Discipline, tries to find himself a role in the new regime, and a replacement for the Imperial throne is about to be announced.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: On his way to Fezzan, Julian spends several days at Heinessen. Here, he pays a visit to Bewcock to hand over a strictly confidential letter from Yang, which exposes his conjectures about the possible move the Imperial forces are likely to make. As Julian finally reaches Fezzan, he is immediately mesmerized by the freedom and affluence that surrounds him, and starts seriously wondering whether he will ever be apt to his new mission.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: A massive fleet led by Oskar von Reuenthal appears in the Iserlohn Corridor. Boasting overwhelming numerical superiority over the defending Alliance forces, the Imperial commander is confident he can crush his opponent in a quick and easy victory. Back on Heinessen, Bewcock warns admirals and MPs that the Empire may be following a less-obvious strategy this time, thus immediate action must be taken to avert the worst. And Yang realizes that his greatest problem of all may not be the approaching enemy ahead, but the supposed friends behind him.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: The unexpected stalemate at the Iserlohn Corridor urges the Imperial Headquarters to muster a reinforcement fleet to be immediately sent in support of Reuenthal. Or at least this is what the Imperial crews believe... but as the fleet jumps out from subspace, it becomes clear that Iserlohn is not their destination. Then Mittermeyer, commander of the fleet, announces that they are about to turn the page in the book of history. On Fezzan, people are staring overhead with anxiety as the sky is filled with ships.

info.title: Detective Conan: Episode "Zero" - Shin'ichi Kudo e il caso dell'acquario
info.synopsis: Qualche tempo prima dell'evento al parco di divertimenti che cambierà la sua vita per sempre, Shin'ichi Kudo si trova all'acquario cittadino con la sua amica Ran per discutere di un piano per far rimettere insieme i genitori della ragazza. Tuttavia, mentre si divertono a guardare i pesci, trovano un uomo a terra che è stato pugnalato a morte.

info.title: Baki-dou: The Invincible Samurai (ITA)
info.synopsis: Baki è annoiato. Dopo la conclusione della battaglia epica tra padre e figlio, lui continua a fare combattimenti underground e ad allenarsi senza fermarsi, ma deve sempre reprimere il suo sbadiglio causato dalla noia. Nessuno stimolo o pericolo può portare eccitazione in lui in questo momento. Ora, con l'inclusione del Primo Ministro Giapponese nel circuito, un grande progetto di clonazione di massa sta provando a clonare Miyamoto Musashi, uno dei padri delle arti marziali in Giappone. Un'altra battaglia di proporzioni epiche attende Baki!

episodes.title: The Unstoppable Yawn
episodes.synopsis: With the greatest father-son battle on earth concluded, Baki experiences overwhelming boredom. Meanwhile, Tokugawa advances his unprecedented experiment.

episodes.title: THE BEAT
episodes.synopsis: As the other martial artists battle restlessness, Kaoru Hanayama asks Tokugawa for a favor. Deep underground, the cloning project enters its final phase.

episodes.title: The Countenance of Musashi
episodes.synopsis: As Professor John accepts Sabuko's arcane methods against scientific reasoning, Hanayama gears up for an all-out fistfight with Yujiro on Tokyo's streets.

episodes.title: Boy
episodes.synopsis: After facing Japan's greatest modern swordsman, the peerless Musashi Miyamoto demands the most skilled fighters in the country. Baki steps forward.

episodes.title: Otherworldly Strength
episodes.synopsis: Baki unleashes his fastest strike — but the samurai is faster. Later, as Musashi roams the city, his actions catch the attention of other martial artists.

episodes.title: Real Sword
episodes.synopsis: The first to move is Doppo Orochi. After a brief tussle, he asks Musashi to use a real blade. How will God's Hand fare against the sword saint's steel?

episodes.title: Feather
episodes.synopsis: Sea King Retsu arrives to face Musashi and trains intensively under the watchful eye of Sea Emperor Kaku to master the secret technique: Xiaoli.

episodes.title: You Are Defeated!
episodes.synopsis: The battle between kenpo master Retsu and sword master Musashi Miyamoto begins! While Retsu unleashes long-range weapon attacks, Musashi closes in!?

episodes.title: Sea King Retsu
episodes.synopsis: Barely standing after Musashi's barrage of brutal attacks, Retsu forces his broken body forward and adopts a familiar stance. Can he turn the tide?

episodes.title: Sekigahara
episodes.synopsis: The deathmatch between Retsu and Musashi comes to a devastatingly brutal conclusion. Baki visits Izo Motobe for guidance and flies into a rage.

episodes.title: Buddy
episodes.synopsis: After defeating Japan's kendo champ, Musashi faces jujutsu master Goki Shibukawa, who greets the samurai with a firm handshake — and a punch to the face.

episodes.title: Tough Body
episodes.synopsis: The strongest being on Earth clashes with the strongest samurai in history at the Tokugawa estate! Yujiro demands Musashi face him with two swords.

episodes.title: Practical Fighter
episodes.synopsis: Jack Hammer arrives at the Tokugawa estate hoping to fight Musashi, but first must defeat Motobe, who's determined to be the next to take on the samurai.

info.title: Go For It, Nakamura-kun!!
info.synopsis: Nakamura è un ragazzo timidissimo che si innamora a prima vista di un suo compagno di classe, Hirose. Il problema? I due non si sono neanche mai rivolti la parola e Nakamura è talmente impacciato da rischiare di complicare le cose prima ancora che inizino!

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Shy high school first-year, Nakamura Okuto, falls in love at first sight with his classmate, Hirose Aiki.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: One morning, the classroom is thrown into chaos when something small and dark scurries across the floor.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Nakamura is completely unmotivated to sketch in art class until Hirose is chosen as the model.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: While Nakamura is brooding and emitting a negative aura, he’s recruited by Aokiyama Reiko for her club.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: Hirose’s rubbing his muscles, sitting in his lap, and holding hands... with a male friend?!

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: The class takes a field trip to Yokohama’s Chinatown.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: The Drama/AV Club plans to make a film about the ghost story the whole school is talking about.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: Nakamura is overjoyed to walk home with Hirose, but a handsome boy is waiting for them at the gate.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: Nakamura yearns to walk around the school festival with Hirose, but instead, he finds himself alone.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: Nakamura studies at the library with Hirose and attends the signing event of his favorite author.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: Nakamura shops for a Christmas present for Hirose and accidentally cuts his bangs too short.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: It’s Valentine’s Day, and Nakamura is secretly nervous about giving “friend chocolate” to Hirose.

episodes.title: Episodio 13
episodes.synopsis: Nakamura learns Hirose has a girlfriend and decides to secretly support them, but...

info.title: Don Dracula (ITA)
info.synopsis: Il Conte Dracula, dopo aver vissuto per anni in Transilvania, è venuto ad abitare a Tokyo con la figlia Ciocolla e si è inserito nella vita giapponese. La figlia va al liceo, ma è costretta a frequentare le scuole serali perché essendo un vampiro non sopporta la luce del sole. Ed è proprio per questo particolare che il terribile dottor Helsing, perennemente a caccia di vampiri, che si è fatto assumere nella scuola come insegnante, riesce ad individuarla e a scoprire quindi anche il padre.

episodes.title: Arriva Don Dracula
episodes.synopsis: For no apparent reason, Don Dracula, the vampire, and his beloved daughter Chocola happen to move to Japan from Romania. They live peacefully in Nerima, a remote area outside Tokyo, until Hellsing, an expert on destroying vampires, comes after them from Holland.

episodes.title: La grotta dei vampiri
episodes.synopsis: Earl Dracula finds it difficult to adjust to Japanese culture, which is very different from Romanian culture. His daughter Chocola, however, looks much happier here than in the boring Romanian castle. Getting anxious about Chocola, who is going to a disco yet again, he also ventures out into the town. There, he and Chocola come into contact with the "Japan Friendship Club of Vampires," but...

episodes.title: Patto col diavolo
episodes.synopsis: Inside a parcel delivered to their house at midnight is a portrait of a terribly distorted-looking man. They hang it on the wall, but feel disgusted to look at it. When they try to take it off the wall, they find it is stuck there. Moreover, the man in the picture emerges from the frame and sneaks into Chocola's room.

episodes.title: Bambole viventi
episodes.synopsis: Chocola and her boyfriend Nobuhiko are strolling on the beach when they find a building called "Research Institute for Exterminating Vampires." Out of curiosity, Chocola and Earl Dracula sneak into the building. Then women made of vinyl appear in front of them.

episodes.title: Il commercio di Dracula
episodes.synopsis: School examinations will begin in a few days at the school Chocola attends. She tries to study hard, but cannot concentrate at all because Earl Dracula makes such a ridiculous fuss every night. After she scolds him, Earl Dracula makes a cheating pencil to help her with her exam and puts it stealthily into her bag, but...

episodes.title: Il mistero dello spirito della scuola
episodes.synopsis: The science fiction club room at the school Chocola attends is going to be used as a storeroom. So the students look for a new room. Finally they find a house that used to be a cram school, and decide to rent it. The house, however, turns out to be haunted by demons. Poltergeist phenomena occur one after another and torment them. So Earl Dracula starts to investigate the house.

episodes.title: Libertà perduta
episodes.synopsis: A beautiful girl is lying on the road at night. Her blood has been sucked by Earl Dracula. In contemporary Japan, however, nobody would believe that she has been attacked by Dracula. So the residents who have found her take the assault to have been by an animal when they see the wounds, made by sharp teeth, on her neck. Moreover, it has been in the news that a tiger and a panda have escaped during transport and are wandering about the neighborhood. People think it is the tiger that has attacked her, and try to capture the panda and shoot the tiger. As Chocola has become friends with the animals, she gets angry with the people, wondering why they do not try to save both animals.

episodes.title: Dracula dal dentista
episodes.synopsis: Earl Dracula is craving for blood. He has not had the fresh blood of beautiful women for days. He will die of starvation. When he finally finds a beautiful woman, he sneaks into her bedroom. He is about to bite her neck when he discovers that she has had dinner garnished with plenty of garlic. Finding it more than he can bear, he runs away only to faint from hunger. Then comes an ambulance with a red-cross mark! The environment in this country is way too much for Dracula to live in.

info.title: Bananya: At-Home Party
info.synopsis: Un gattino si sveglia improvvisamente in un mondo sconosciuto popolato da curiose creature e si rende conto di essersi trasformato lui stesso in un Bananya. Uniti da questo imprevisto, il piccolo e i suoi nuovi compagni intraprendono un viaggio attraverso foreste e montagne, decisi a ritrovare il lucente tesoro perduto di uno di loro.

episodes.title: Bananya: At-Home Party
episodes.synopsis: When I woke up, I was in an unfamiliar world. In front of me was a cat peeking out of a banana, a "Bananya." I couldn't believe my eyes. For some reason, my body was also made of a banana...

info.title: Magical Girl Raising Project: Restart
info.synopsis: Il gioco mortale è tornato! Sedici Ragazze Magiche vengono riunite per affrontare una sfida ad altissimo rischio. Ogni tre giorni, il loro Magical Phone le trascina in una simulazione simile a un RPG, dove dovranno collaborare per sconfiggere nemici, risolvere enigmi e ottenere Magical Candy. Ad attenderle alla fine ci sono ben dieci miliardi di yen, ma il premio spetterà soltanto a chi infliggerà il colpo di grazia. Con una ricompensa così allettante, è solo questione di tempo prima che le ragazze inizino a combattersi tra loro. E quando i loro punti vita raggiungeranno lo zero, il game over sarà solo l'inizio dei loro problemi...

episodes.title: Ciao, Daisy
episodes.synopsis: Pechka è una maga modesta e senza pretese la cui magia le permette di cucinare piatti deliziosi, dote che sfrutta per preparare il pranzo al ragazzo per cui ha una cotta. La sua semplice vita quotidiana viene stravolta del tutto quando viene rapita con la forza e trascinata in un inquietante mondo di gioco. Insieme a Pechka, sono sedici le ragazze magiche radunate lì. In questo spazio virtuale artificiale, si alza in silenzio il sipario su un incubo tanto splendido quanto crudele.

episodes.title: The Players
episodes.synopsis: Sixteen magical girls have been assembled in a vast virtual world. The electronic fairy Fal announces a team competition with a 10-billion-yen grand prize, where players must collect “Candy.” With Pechka panicking over her complete lack of combat ability, Clantail takes the lead in redistributing the Candy. But could this become the seed of quiet mistrust among the group?
